scope: Conditional TE2 one-factor checks at seed 0. All full normalized trajectories, signed and absolute integrals, antigen composition, fields, spatial observations, baseline N3 ranges and completed baseline numerical context are retained.
interpretation: Growth alternatives materially change target trajectories and residuals; endpoint-only reporting misses substantial 2D changes.
A larger effector population under the background-loss alternative is accompanied by small target differences of mixed sign. Small target differences coexist with material local-entry field changes.

The tested interval and endpoint representation order persists in these nine finite configurations, but every pairwise curve crosses. This is not general robustness to parameter changes or a pure-dimensionality result.
IFNG and TNF fields remain identical relative-unit fields with different assigned roles. Their duplicate flags do not represent independent biological evidence.
Baseline numerical shifts are context only, not transferable kinetic error bars. No asymptotic convergence, biological calibration or in vivo inference follows.
parameter_basis_limitation: Material parameter choices lack a complete quantitative basis for the present system. Literature findings from different systems do not establish calibration.
